articles.title: Employee Benefits Data Takes Center Stage in Broker Renewal Negotiations
articles.summary: Employee benefits data and analytics are increasingly driving broker renewal discussions as self-funded employers seek greater transparency and cost containment. This shift matters because robust data allows organizations to pinpoint cost drivers, particularly in pharmacy benefits, and make informed plan adjustments. For business operations, brokers and employers must leverage advanced data insights to negotiate better value, optimize plan performance, and control escalating healthcare expenditures.
